U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to hold a landmark trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday, November 19, on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting. The gathering is historic because it brings together the heads of the world's three most influential military powers in a formal three-way setting for the first time amid deep global fractures.
Thank you for watching our video!
